crime: At school, {WITCH_NAME}'s classmates shuffled on their knees until their lunch circle closed over her place. No one said a word.
In the prison, her roommate was a diver. Every dawn she sat on the bottom of the lake holding a stone, while {WITCH_NAME} floated face down on the surface above her.
Then her roommate began teaching the other prisoners. Soon she was seating them in a ring on the lake bottom, hands joined, and {WITCH_NAME} could never stay under long enough to join it.

On the bank, in front of the girls, {WITCH_NAME} asked her, "Do you still want me with you?" Under her Magic, her roommate could not lie, dodge or stay silent. "Under the water is the one place you can't ask me anything," she answered.
The next dawn, {WITCH_NAME} whispered her roommate's name into the water. Far below, her roommate looked up.
The dawn after that, as the dive neared its end, {WITCH_NAME} asked into the water, "Do you still want me?" Her roommate had to answer, and the answer spent her last breath.
When the count passed three minutes, one of the prisoners dove in and brought her up, drowned, the stone still in her lap.

The prisoners had watched the whole dive from the bank. Her roommate had said herself that no question could reach her under the water, so they ruled {WITCH_NAME} out: the girl must have blacked out down there.
Then, at the courtyard fountain, one prisoner put her head under while another asked a question into the water. She heard every word.
In the trial court, the prisoners understood. That answer on the bank had only been what her roommate believed. The question from above had reached her, and her own answer had drowned her.
fields.epitaph: She was only holding her breath; she was never shutting you out.
fields.epithet: The Girl Who Floats Outside Every Ring
execution: The execution stand raises a ring of iron girls with a single gap, and she stands chained in it.
No one gives a signal. The iron girls begin to shuffle sideways toward the gap.
Iron shoulders press into her chest from both sides.
Iron hands reach for each other across her, and the ring closes over her place.
Then they stand still, hands joined, her bowed head inside the whole ring.

magic.name: Nothing But the Truth
magic.text: Anyone she asks a question must answer truthfully: no lies, no dodging, no silence.
